snippet.title: Winter Burrow Nintendo Switch Announcement | Wholesome Direct 2025
snippet.description: NEW PLATFORM: Winter Burrow is a cozy woodland survival game where you explore a frozen wilderness from the safety of your warm home burrow. We're thrilled to share the exclusive news that Winter Burrow is coming to Nintendo Switch! https://linktr.ee/winterburrow #WholesomeDirect #SummerGameFest #CozyGames
